titulo: Three replies to a new idea
caption:
Three replies to a new idea

I used to answer a new idea with yes, but. Then I started saying tell me more.

A but ends an idea before it has a shape, and a question lets the other person finish building it.

For whoever asks for more before judging.

Choose friction.

More of this: link in bio.

alt: A short film with no voice, with music. A terracotta room with a staircase on the right and a navy figure that says I have an idea. in each of three labeled scenes. The but: a teal figure says yes, but... and the navy one narrows its eyes. The shrug: a brown figure looks down and says sure, whatever. while the navy one looks away. The lean-in: an ink-black figure leans toward the navy one and says tell me more., and the navy one answers with happy eyes. The text stays: three kinds of hearing an idea. The last card: Choose friction.
comentario_fijado: A small friction, chosen on purpose.
